mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an aggressive monetary easing stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates severe labor market distress, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 460 and retail sales below 340,000 signal a sharp consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 460 and RSAFS < 340000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 95.0 indicates manufacturing sector deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days during early recession phases.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 460 consistently signal weak consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 460.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation below 1.0% signals deflationary pressure, prompting economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll declines below 132,000 and unemployment rises above 9.0% indicate labor market collapse, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 132000 and UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production rising above 100.0 indicates manufacturing sector strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during early recovery phases.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0.
